content_zh:
“嗤。”
铁箭带着破空之声，向刘枫头部射去。
刘枫动了动被泥缠着的双退，却没有挣开。
铁箭眨眼便至，大厅中的众人脸上都不由露出一丝兴奋的笑容。
他们很喜欢，箭支入体的美妙声音，和鲜血飞撒的美丽场景。
可是，这次他们会很失望。
刘枫看着那在眼中不断变大的箭支，嘴角勾起一个不屑的弧度。
“瞬。”
大厅中的众人，有些不敢置信的看着那处空空的地方。
在一秒中之前，那里有一个即将被射死之人。
尤其是上方的默土，眼中的惊骇之色颜露于表。
猛的一声大喝：“小心，围拢来。”
大厅中的众人，再怎么说也是在一起合作的几年乃至十几年的伙伴。
极为默契。
喝声刚落，众人已经背靠背的聚拢在了一起，十几双眼睛，不断的在厅中来回搜索。
默土满脸凝重的从坐椅旁边，握住那紧靠着的魔法杖。
魔法杖一到手，似乎为他增添了几分胆气，低声喝道：“这位朋友，我知道今天对于肯斯兄弟的事，我们做的过了点，可是毕竟他们现在也没有时候事，而且你也伤了我们团里的悟凯，此事可否就此揭过？”
“世界上。。没有后悔药可吃的。”一声低吟，在耳边轻轻响起。
默土身体猛的一僵，冷汗瞬间将后背打的湿透，满脸骇然。
“他是``是```什么时候？来到身后的？”

底下的佣兵们也察觉到了，团长的危机。
有些迟疑的互相看了看，有心上去救人，可是那鬼魅般的速度，也死死的在脑海之中浮现。
脚下似生了跟一般，移不动半毫。
“怎么？你们不打算救他了吗？”轻笑声在大厅中回荡，宛如催命的死神，跗骨如蛆。
咽了一口口水，默土干涩道：“朋友，你到底想怎么样？”
嘴上极其小心的说着话语，右手却悄悄的动了动，一截卷轴皮，轻轻的从宽大的魔法袖袍里滑下。
“我们可以和你赔礼道歉的，你想要钱？还是要女人？”一丝魔力顺着右手，轻轻的触动着魔法卷轴。
默土心中狂喜：“一点时间，再给我一点时间。。。”
可是狂喜还没来得及发出，就被一声低叹打得僵硬无比：“哎，本来是想让你多活一会，谁知道你自己要找死，奈何？”
“噗”。
默土傻傻的看着从胸口冒出来的一截剑尖，神智慢慢的模糊了起来。
这便是死亡的感觉吗？
看也不看，迅速的失去生机的默土，刘枫直接从上面踏过，看着下方如临大敌的众人，嘴角划起一个阴险，狡猾的弧度。
“你们有机会活下去。”
一句笑语，拉起了众人的希望。
“不过，只能有一个人。。。”
欣喜尽去，只余苍白。
沉默。。死一般的沉默。
在死亡的临近下，昔日的友情遭到了严峻的考验。
死亡其实并不可怕，可怕的是死亡前的片刻。

“你们可以保持沉默，”刘枫微微一笑，随脚踢翻桌上的酒杯，绿色的美酒倾泻而下：“不过，这杯酒倒光之前，那么。。。协议做废。”
众人脸色急急变幻。
依旧沉默，只余那酒滴在地上的滴答声。
刘枫却似并不着急，依然一副笑脸，可是这在下方众人眼中，晃若恶魔的狞笑。
“滴答。。滴答。。”
酒水越来越少，一滴一滴的轻轻砸在地上，众人心脏随之跳动。
在死亡面前，终有承受不住的。
位于后方的一人，眼神连连变幻，最后定格。
手中骑士剑缓缓举起，对准前面同伴的后心，狠狠的刺了下去。
“啊。”一声惨叫，将死寂的气氛打破。
在死亡的压迫之下，众人也开始了疯狂。
手中的凶器，毫不留情的向昔日的同伴砍去。
大厅中，惨叫不断，殷红的鲜血在灯光的照耀下，炫出一种妖异的色彩。
刘枫眼神极其冷漠的看着下面，修罗般的场景。
人数在互相砍杀中急速减少。
刘枫晃动着随手端来的一杯红酒，眼光从其中透过，下面遍地的死尸，在红酒的衬托下，更显几分狰狞。
当最后一个，满身血痕的人，用手中大剑支撑着身体，遥遥晃晃的站起来，双眼死死的盯着刘枫：“我赢了，放我走。。”
从其身上穿着的骑士铠甲来看，他应该是一名骑士。
不过骑士的美德：公平，友爱，和善等等，在他的身上找不出一丝来。
刘枫轻轻抬了抬了眼皮，随意的挥了挥手，似在赶苍蝇。

content_en:
"Tsk."
The iron arrow shot towards Liu Feng's head with a sound of breaking through the air.
Liu Feng moved his hands that were entangled in the mud to retreat, but did not break away.
The iron arrow arrived in the blink of an eye, and everyone in the hall could not help but reveal a hint of excited smiles on their faces.
They liked the beautiful sound of the arrow entering the body and the beautiful scene of blood flying.
However, this time they will be disappointed.
Liu Feng looked at the arrow that was getting bigger and bigger in his eyes, and the corners of his mouth curled up in a disdainful arc.
"Shun."
Everyone in the hall looked at the empty place in disbelief.
One second ago, there was a man there who was about to be shot.
Especially Motu above, the look of horror in his eyes was evident.
He shouted loudly: "Be careful, surround us."
Everyone in the hall is, after all, partners who have been working together for several years or even more than ten years.
Very tacit understanding.
As soon as the shouts ended, everyone had gathered back to back, with more than a dozen pairs of eyes constantly searching back and forth in the hall.
Motu walked away from the chair with a solemn expression, holding the magic wand that was close to him.
As soon as the magic wand was in hand, it seemed to add a little more courage to him, and he shouted in a low voice: "Friend, I know that we went too far today regarding the Kensi brothers, but after all, they have no time to deal with now, and you also hurt Wu Kai in our group. Can this matter be revealed?"
"There is no regret medicine in this world." A low moan sounded softly in his ears.
Motu's body suddenly stiffened, and his back was instantly soaked with cold sweat, his face full of shock.
"When did he come from behind?"
The mercenaries below also noticed the captain's crisis.
They looked at each other hesitantly, intending to go up to save people, but the ghostly speed still lingered in their minds.
There seemed to be a heel under my feet, and I couldn't move even an inch.
"What? Aren't you going to save him?" The soft laughter echoed in the hall, like the god of death urging death, and the tarsus bones were like maggots.
After swallowing a sip of saliva, Motu said dryly: "Friend, what do you want?"
While speaking the words extremely carefully, his right hand moved quietly, and a piece of scroll skin gently slid down from the wide magic sleeve robe.
"We can apologize to you. Do you want money? Or a woman?" A trace of magic followed the right hand and gently touched the magic scroll.
Motu was ecstatic in his heart: "A little time, give me a little more time..."
But before he could express his ecstasy, he was stiffened by a low sigh: "Hey, I originally wanted you to live a little longer, but who knew you were looking for death? What could I do?"
"Poof".
Motu stared blankly at the sword tip protruding from his chest, his consciousness slowly becoming blurry.
Is this what death feels like?
Without looking at Motu, who quickly lost his vitality, Liu Feng stepped directly over it. Looking at the people below who looked like they were facing a formidable enemy, the corner of his mouth drew a sinister and cunning arc.
"You have a chance to survive."
A joke raised everyone's hopes.
"However, there can only be one person..."
The joy is gone, leaving only paleness.
silence. . Deathly silence.
As death approaches, former friendships are severely tested.
Death is not actually scary, what is scary is the moments before death.
"You can remain silent," Liu Feng smiled slightly and kicked over the wine glass on the table, and the green wine poured down: "But before this glass of wine is poured out, then...the agreement will be void."
Everyone's expressions changed rapidly.
Still silent, only the sound of wine dripping on the ground was left.
Liu Feng didn't seem to be in a hurry and still had a smile on his face, but in the eyes of the people below, he looked like a devil's evil smile.
"Tick tock...tick tock..."
The drinks were getting less and less, and they hit the ground drop by drop, making everyone's hearts beat.
In the face of death, there is always acceptanceUnbearable.
The eyes of the person at the back changed continuously and finally settled.
The knight's sword in his hand was slowly raised, aimed at the back of the companion in front of him, and stabbed him hard.
"Ah." A scream broke the dead silence.
Under the oppression of death, everyone began to go crazy.
The murderous weapon in his hand was mercilessly slashing at his former companions.
In the hall, screams continued, and the bright red blood showed off a strange color under the light.
Liu Feng looked at the Shura-like scene below with extremely cold eyes.
The number of people was rapidly reduced while killing each other.
Liu Feng swayed the glass of red wine he brought casually and looked through it. The dead bodies lying everywhere below looked even more ferocious against the backdrop of the red wine.
When the last man, covered in bloodstains, supported his body with the big sword in his hand, he stood up unsteadily, staring at Liu Feng with his eyes: "I win, let me go."
Judging from the knight armor he wore, he should be a knight.
However, none of the knight's virtues: fairness, friendship, kindness, etc. can be found in him.
Liu Feng raised his eyelids slightly and waved his hand casually, as if to shoo away flies.
